en_title: Activision Confirms Brand New Call of Duty Subfranchise Is in the Works, Leading to Rampant Fan Speculation
cn_title: 《使命召唤》确认开发全新子系列
subtitle: 熟面孔之外
opus_summary: Activision确认正在开发《使命召唤》新子系列，尚未公布负责团队及发售时间。外界普遍认为这是Sledgehammer预计明年推出的新作，系列未来将更重视创新。

paragraphs.en: Activision is actively developing a new Call of Duty subfranchise, suggesting it is ready to move on from Black Ops and Modern Warfare for the time being.
paragraphs.cn: Activision正在积极开发《使命召唤》的全新子系列，看来已准备暂时跳出《黑色行动》和《现代战争》这两个子系列。

paragraphs.en: In a new interview with The Game Business , Activision's Chief Marketing Officer, Tyler Bahl, confirmed that one of its studios is developing a new Call of Duty subfranchise. Although Bahl didn't state which studio is making it or when it would release, it is widely believed this will be the next game from Sledgehammer Games, expected to release next year. He also noted that Modern Warfare 4 will conclude the story that Infinity Ward has been telling since 2019, but suggested that universe could continue in the future with certain characters.
paragraphs.cn: Activision首席营销官Tyler Bahl近日接受The Game Business采访时确认，旗下一家工作室正在开发《使命召唤》的全新子系列。Bahl没有透露负责开发的工作室，也未公布发售时间，但外界普遍认为，这就是Sledgehammer Games预计明年推出的下一款作品。他还指出，《现代战争4》将为Infinity Ward自2019年以来讲述的故事画上句号，不过他也暗示，未来仍可能围绕部分角色，在这一宇宙中继续讲述故事。

paragraphs.en: However, Activision believes the path forward for Call of Duty is less about leaning on legacy franchises and familiar faces, and more about innovation.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，Activision认为，《使命召唤》未来的发展应更多依靠创新，而不是倚重既有子系列和熟悉的角色。

paragraphs.en: “Where we go with future games, we have to innovate," said Bahl. "What we heard from the audience is they want new or better or different. The landscape is changing right under our feet. You’re seeing new games being built overnight, and you’re seeing tastes change and how people want to play.”
paragraphs.cn: Bahl表示：「无论未来的游戏朝哪个方向发展，我们都必须创新。我们从玩家那里听到的是，他们想要新的、更好的，或是不一样的东西。我们身处的环境正在发生变化。你能看到新游戏一夜之间就做出来了，也能看到玩家的喜好和他们想要的游玩方式都在改变。」

paragraphs.en: These comments have led to all kinds of speculation about where the next Call of Duty game will go. Will they try to go into the future? The far-flung past? What kind of mechanic can they introduce to make it feel fresh without changing things up too much? Well, a rumor from Call of Duty leaker TheGhostofHope in 2025 may provide some insight, assuming it pans out.
paragraphs.cn: 这番话引发了人们对下一款《使命召唤》走向的种种猜测。开发团队会尝试把背景设在未来吗？还是遥远的过去？他们能引入怎样的机制，在不做太大改动的前提下带来新鲜感？《使命召唤》爆料人TheGhostofHope在2025年透露的一则传闻，或许能提供一些线索——前提是传闻属实。

paragraphs.en: The rumor suggests that Sledgehammer's next game will have a focus on martial arts, with karate kicks and karate chops. It's possible that Sledgehammer is trying to lean into John Wick's gun-fu combat, which mixes satisfying gunplay with fluid, flashy close-quarters combat. That seems more doable for a third-person game with a heavy emphasis on animations, but a first-person, fast-paced, competitive game may have a harder time implementing that kind of gameplay. If it works out, it could be really compelling, though.
paragraphs.cn: 据这则传闻，Sledgehammer的下一款游戏将着重展现武术，加入空手道踢技和手刀。Sledgehammer或许正尝试采用《疾速追杀》式的枪斗术，将爽快的枪战与流畅、华丽的近身搏斗结合起来。对于注重动作演出的第三人称游戏来说，这似乎更容易实现；但要在第一人称、快节奏的竞技游戏中实现这种玩法，可能会更困难。不过，如果能做成，或许会相当吸引人。

paragraphs.en: Interestingly enough, Sledgehammer Games really began its tenure as a Call of Duty team by trying to innovate. The studio was built with the expectation that it would develop a third-person Call of Duty game set in the Vietnam War, attempting to leverage the team's experience on games like Dead Space to create a new kind of Call of Duty experience. That project was eventually killed as Sledgehammer was pulled in to help develop the original Modern Warfare 3 after Infinity Ward imploded.
paragraphs.cn: 有趣的是，Sledgehammer Games刚开始参与《使命召唤》开发时，尝试的恰恰就是创新。这家工作室成立时，原本计划开发一款以越南战争为背景的第三人称《使命召唤》，利用团队开发《死亡空间》等游戏的经验，打造一种全新的《使命召唤》体验。后来Infinity Ward分崩离析，Sledgehammer被调去协助开发初版《现代战争3》，这个项目最终遭到取消。

paragraphs.en: Still, Sledgehammer tried to innovate again with its first solo title, Advanced Warfare. The game introduced exosuits, allowing players to jump, dash, and slide thanks to enhanced movement mechanics. It was a radical leap for Call of Duty, though fans largely rejected attempts to take the franchise into the future. Since then, Sledgehammer has played it fairly safe with two World War 2 games and a different game that also happened to be titled Modern Warfare 3, ironically enough.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管如此，Sledgehammer还是在首款独立负责开发的作品《高级战争》中再次尝试创新。游戏引入了外骨骼装甲，通过强化移动机制，让玩家能够跳跃、冲刺和滑行。这对《使命召唤》而言是一次大跨越，但玩家大多不接受将系列背景转向未来的尝试。此后，Sledgehammer的路线相当保守，开发了两款二战题材作品，以及另一款恰好也叫《现代战争3》的游戏，颇有些讽刺意味。

paragraphs.en: Whether Sledgehammer Games can make something to excite fans again remains to be seen, but it'll be nice to have a non-MW or Black Ops game for the first time in more than five years.
paragraphs.cn: Sledgehammer Games能否再次拿出让玩家兴奋的作品，还有待观察。不过，时隔五年多，终于能迎来一款既不属于《现代战争》、也不属于《黑色行动》的作品，还是件好事。
